title: LGTM Lite self-monitoring
description: Health and sizing of the stack itself: node and pod usage, PVCs, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo and Alloy

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Firing monitoring or Lgtm alerts. Missing alert telemetry reads zero; it does not prove alert evaluation is healthy.

panels.title: Pod restarts (1h)
panels.description: Monitoring container restarts in one hour. Counter resets or missing scrape history can undercount.

panels.title: Scrape targets down
panels.description: Down monitoring targets plus missing expected backend jobs: monitoring/loki, tempo, and kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus. Extra targets in a job are not an inventory of expected replicas.

targets.expr: (count(up{namespace="monitoring"} == 0) or vector(0)) + (3 - count(count by (job) (up{job=~"monitoring/loki|tempo|kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus"})) or vector(3))

panels.title: Data dropped (1h)
panels.description: Loki discarded samples, Tempo discarded spans and Alloy dropped log entries in one hour. New discard counters lose their first increment; missing counters read zero.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(loki_discarded_samples_total[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(tempo_discarded_spans_total[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(loki_write_dropped_entries_total[1h])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Alert notifications failed (24h)
panels.description: Failed Alertmanager notifications in 24 hours. Missing notification telemetry reads zero and cannot prove delivery.

panels.title: Worst container memory vs limit
panels.description: Highest monitoring container working set divided by its memory limit. Containers without a limit drop out; missing telemetry reads zero.

targets.expr: max(max by (namespace,pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="monitoring",container!="",container!="POD"}) / on (namespace,pod,container) (max by (namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="monitoring",resource="memory"}) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Worst PVC fill
panels.description: Highest used/capacity ratio for monitoring PVCs. Missing volume metrics read zero and object storage is not measured.

panels.title: Stored size per backend
panels.description: Used PVC bytes for each backend, including WAL and local data. Object storage and unreported PVCs are not measured.

panels.title: Prometheus TSDB vs size limit
panels.description: Prometheus block bytes divided by a positive retention size limit. WAL/head bytes are excluded; unset limits or missing telemetry read zero.

panels.title: Retention configured
panels.description: Default retention by backend, not per-tenant overrides. Zero means no deletion; missing telemetry also falls back to zero.

panels.title: Prometheus history depth
panels.description: Elapsed seconds since the oldest Prometheus TSDB sample. Restarts, retention and missing telemetry can shorten the reported history.

panels.title: Metrics ingest
panels.description: Prometheus samples appended per second. This includes internal samples and is not remote-write delivery proof. Missing telemetry reads zero.

panels.title: Logs ingest
panels.description: Loki distributor bytes received per second. Accepted ingestion does not prove durable storage. Missing telemetry reads zero.

panels.title: Traces ingest
panels.description: Tempo distributor spans received per second. Accepted spans do not prove query availability. Missing telemetry reads zero.

panels.title: Loki retention last run
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful Loki retention run. Missing telemetry reads as time since epoch; disabled retention also appears overdue.

panels.title: LGTM node CPU used
panels.description: Busy vCPU on the node running loki-0. Meaningful when placement pins LGTM to its own node; other colocated workloads count too and missing telemetry reads zero.

targets.expr: sum(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[5m]) * on(instance) group_left() label_replace(max by (host_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod="loki-0"}), "instance", "$1:9100", "host_ip", "(.*)")) or vector(0)

panels.title: LGTM node memory used
panels.description: Memory usage on the node running loki-0. Meaningful when placement pins LGTM to its own node; other colocated workloads count too and missing telemetry reads zero.

targets.expr: (1 - sum(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes * on(instance) label_replace(max by (host_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod="loki-0"}), "instance", "$1:9100", "host_ip", "(.*)")) / sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes * on(instance) label_replace(max by (host_ip) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod="loki-0"}), "instance", "$1:9100", "host_ip", "(.*)"))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Memory by pod
panels.description: Working set; the largest is usually Prometheus, which grows with active series

panels.title: PVC used
panels.description: LgtmPvcFilling fires at 75 / 90 / 95%

panels.title: Active series
panels.description: Memory follows this. kubelet / cAdvisor and the API server account for most of it on an idle cluster

panels.title: Loki streams
panels.description: Active streams; a jump means a high-cardinality label reached the stream labels
